subject: ConcordAI renewal launch: milestones, staffing & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alex Stein <alex@concordai.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@concordai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: ConcordAI renewal launch: milestones, staffing & QBR scheduling

Hi Alex / Priya —

Congrats on the adoption progress this year. Per our renewal cadence, I'd like to kick off the formal renewal + expansion planning so we have a clean runway for the FY27 commit and the burst capacity you flagged for holiday traffic. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm target term (12 vs 24 months) and any headcount constraints for procurement.
- Lock proposed capacity uplift (tokens/day and burst headroom) so we can size Dedicated pools.
- Align on exec stakeholders and a QBR window in September for an exec readout.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
1) This week: mutual action plan and baseline numbers
2) Next 2 weeks: procurement/legal redlines + capacity sizing
3) Early Sep: QBR with VP/Product & VP/Infra (30–45 min)

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan and a QBR agenda template to speed things up. Can you confirm availability for a 30 min sync on Tuesday 08/18 or Wednesday 08/19? If either works, I'll pull in Marissa and Rishi to cover pricing and capacity runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
con-nor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Concord_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, QBR-Agenda-Concord.docx
From: Alex Stein <alex@concordai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@concordai.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ConcordAI renewal launch: milestones, staffing & QBR scheduling

Thanks Connor — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers up front:

- Term: leaning toward 24 months but need to confirm with finance (we should know by Wednesday).
- Capacity: product team expects a 2.5x steady‑state uplift plus ~4x holiday burst; we'll share token estimates by Tue 8/18.
- QBR: Sep 8–10 windows look promising for our leadership.

Tuesday 08/18 at 11:00am PT would work for a short sync. Please include pricing and a short ops checklist (what you need from us to size Dedicated pools).

I'll bring Priya (procurement) and Andrew (VP Prod) if we need deeper signals.

—Alex
Alex Stein
Head of Platform, ConcordAI
alex@concordai.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alex Stein <alex@concordai.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@concordai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ConcordAI renewal launch: milestones, staffing & QBR scheduling

Great — locking Tue 08/18 11:00am PT for a 30 min sync. Agenda for the call (short):

1) Confirm target term + procurement timeline (Priya)
2) Walk through capacity uplift numbers and headroom (Alex)
3) Pricing bands / committed capacity options (Marissa will cover)
4) Ops checklist for Dedicated onboarding + migration runway (Rishi)
5) QBR windows and exec invite list

Pre-reads attached (same MAP + agenda). Rishi — can you paste a short ops checklist in the thread so Alex/Priya know what we'll ask for? Marissa — I'll hand to you for pricing options on the call.

Thanks all,
Connor

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Alex Stein <alex@concordai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@concordai.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Ops checklist and Dedicated sizing inputs for ConcordAI

Alex / team — quick ops checklist to prepare before our Tue 08/18 sync:

Required for initial Dedicated sizing:
- Peak and average tokens/day (last 30 / 90 day baselines)
- Typical sequence length distribution (P95 and median)
- Percent of requests requiring streaming vs non‑streaming
- KV cache hit rate expectations (if you use long context features)
- Any hard latency SLOs (95th percentile target)

Optional but helpful:
- Representative sample prompts (sanitized) for perf testing
- Expected growth rate month-over-month for next 6 months
- Planned heavy traffic dates (holiday windows) with estimated multipliers

If you can paste the baseline numbers into the HubSpot deal record before Tue we'll run a quick capacity sweep and share two config options (economy vs performance) in advance.

I'll also include a minimalist migration checklist on the call so you can see which pieces we own vs Concord's infra team.

—Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.m@redwood.com
From: Alex Stein <alex@concordai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@concordai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ConcordAI renewal launch: milestones, staffing & QBR scheduling

All right — 08/18 11:00am PT confirmed. Priya will lead procurement questions; Andrew is tentatively on for the QBR but we'll confirm next week.

I'll upload baseline token numbers and the holiday multipliers to the HubSpot deal by EOD Monday. Also confirmed: leaning 24 months but will finalize after finance review.

See you on Tue.

—Alex
